subject: an interlocking coral arch and an ivory notched disc
pose: shapes tilted in a compact asymmetric balance
art_direction: 珊瑚拱形与缺口月盘交错，靛蓝和奶油色块构成清楚抽象头像。
visible_description: 珊瑚拱形与缺口月盘交错，靛蓝和奶油色块构成清楚抽象头像。
composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Create an interlocking coral arch and an ivory notched disc. Keep the arch thick and the disc partly hidden behind it, creating one readable central structure. Use a small indigo rectangular plane as a counterweight, not a border. One soft shadow separates the overlapping forms. The background remains pale cream, with no texture beyond a faint paper presence. Use hard-edge abstract illustration. Square 1024x1024 avatar; keep the central subject clear, with no text, logo, watermark, or circular border.
